description: The library exposes an activation entry point that returns an object whose member is the Markdown slide-extension hook; applying that hook to a Markdown engine and rendering through it must produce slide output markers when the document opts in. These boundary scenarios obtain the hook from the activation entry and render both a slide-mode document, probing several slide markers, and a document that does not opt in, confirming the hook is reported present while the slide markers stay absent. The input requests the activation entry and supplies the Markdown source plus the markers to probe; output first reports that the extension hook is present, then reports each requested marker.
